organic_results.title: Can You See the Great Wall of China from Space? | NASA
organic_results.snippet: The Great Wall of China, frequently billed as the only man-made object visible from space, generally isn't visible from low Earth orbit without aid.

organic_results.title: Is the Great Wall of China Visible from Space? - Scientific American
organic_results.snippet: Despite claims, the Great Wall is very difficult to see from space and is generally not visible to the unaided eye from orbit.

news_results.snippet: Experts continue to debunk the popular myth that the Great Wall is visible from space, calling it one of history's most persistent misconceptions.

organic_results.snippet: Our analysis concludes that the Great Wall's width of approximately 5 metres makes it imperceptible to the naked eye from low-Earth orbit.
